strings: r_c0 watches, bemused, as m_c dashes into {PRONOUN/r_c0/poss} den, bouncing around cheerfully while babbling something, before zooming off again into the camp.
m_c's energy always brings joy to the rest of the Clan, but sometimes {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/seem/seems} to have far too much of it.
The peace of the camp is hardly disturbed by m_c playing around like a young kitten.
m_c feels filled with the need to move, to jump around and just go, go, go!
